Marta: heads-up: onboarding new-13b-q4v3-alt and seeing reproducible tiny reordering around 12288->12290 when eviction kicks in (eviction_policy=aggressive). anyone seen tokenizer splits + kv-evict interact? :confused:
Sam: can you paste minimal repro? is this single-card?
Marta: single-card (A100-80G), runner flags below. repro uses tokenized prompt with a long doc that contains rare unicode near the border.
Marta: ```bash
# repro (single GPU)
python tools/run_long.py --model new-13b-q4v3-alt \n  --cache-mode ropecache --seq-len 24576 --eviction-policy aggressive \n  --kv-compact-on-pressure 1 --tokenizer bytebpe-v2 --prompt tests/rare_unicode_long.txt \n  --seed 42 --save-trace /tmp/trace_kv.json
```
Noah: saw something similar once — tokenizer splitting an emoji into multiple BPE tokens => pos offsets shift when we compact KV. Could be recompute vs cached pos mapping mismatch.
Lee: important detail: our rotary kernel assumes absolute_pos = base_counter + local_pos. if compacting drops entries and we shift base_counter without updating pos_map we get aliasing.
Raj: do we also leak quant rounding into the rot matrices? q4 variants sometimes clip values slightly differently during matmul reorder which can amplify at boundaries.
Marta: observed behavior: softmax top3 reorder for 3-4 tokens exactly when eviction log appears, then stabilized. not a catastrophic fork. logs: 
Marta: ```
[INFO] step=12284 top3=["data","the","on"]
[INFO] kv: compact_triggered pressure=0.82 removed=256 new_base=12288
[INFO] step=12288 top3=["data","on","the"]  <-- slight reorder
[INFO] step=12292 top3=["data","the","on"]
```
Sam: can you try disabling kv_compact_on_pressure? also try fp16 run for baseline.
Marta: did fp16 baseline earlier — clean. starting q4v3-alt with compact_off now.
ci-bot: job kv-evict-q4-alt-4942 queued -> running on dev-gpu-07
bench-bot: quick-check: delta_logprob=0.038 top1-flips=2 at steps [12288,20345] (threshold=1)
Sam: that suggests quant is amplifying small index misalignments. we should dump tokenizer boundary tokens and per-kv-entry pos stamps at compaction.
Noah: I can add a tiny hook to the tokenizer to mark bytes-offset->token-index mapping in the trace. patch incoming.
Lee: I'll instrument the compact codepath to emit a compact_map: [[old_index->new_index]] and a compact_checksum for rot matrices.
Marta: created trace dir s3://redwood-dev/kv-evict/4942109999/q4-alt, uploading current artifacts there.
Marta: launching run with --dump-token-map --dump-compaction-map.
Marta: also noticed the rare unicode sequence includes a soft hyphen (U+00AD) which our tokenizer sometimes drops across BPE merges. could be causing 1-token slip.
Raj: test plan: (1) fp16 baseline (n=2), (2) q4v3-alt compact_on (n=3), (3) q4v3-alt compact_off (n=3), (4) q4v3-alt compact_on + tokenizer-strict (n=2). collect rot matrices and compact_map.
Marta: agreed. also add a microtest: simulate compaction by dropping entries at boundary and validate pos remapping is identity for tokens present in new window.
Lee: added unit test in model-adapter: tests/test_kv_compaction_posmap.py. will push.
Sam: patch landed: https://git.redwood.internal/r/eng-ml/kv-compact-debug/+/5
Sam: quick note: the compact_map dump shows an off-by-1 in mapping when the removed count is a multiple of 128 (our shard quantum).
Marta: interesting — shard quantum interaction. maybe compaction loop uses integer division floor somewhere. can someone grep for //128 or /128 in the compaction code?
Noah: on it. found candidate: compact_batches = removed_count / SHARD_QUANTUM; using integer division in Python 3? maybe accidental float->int trunc.
Raj: even if compaction mapping is correct, quant kernel reorder (packed matmul) might apply a different rounding at boundaries when matrix dims change. need to compare raw rot matrices between fp16 and q4.
Marta: uploading rot dumps: s3://redwood-dev/kv-evict/4942109999/artifacts/rot_dumps.tar.gz
Sam: experiments so far: q4v3-alt + compact_on reproduces reorders reliably with seed 42. compact_off run shows no flip. that pins compaction as trigger.
Lee: created quick fix: apply pos_offset correction during compaction commit and assert mapping continuity. opened PR: https://git.redwood.internal/r/eng-ml/kv-compact-fix/+/3
ci-bot: PR eng-ml/kv-compact-fix (build) 01 passed01
Marta: will run q4v3-alt with the fix and compare. kicking off job now.
Marta: also adding tokenizer-strict option to avoid soft-hyphen folding in these long runs.
bench-bot: regression-scan: before_fix flips=2, after_fix flips=0 on quick replicate (n=1).
Marta: nice. once we have stable multi-replicate results I'll open model-adoption ticket with RCA.
Raj: follow-ups: - add fuzz harness that simulates compaction at random points - add CI gating test on model-adapter that runs a short compact simulation - ensure quant kernels include guard when matrix dim changes midstream
Marta: thanks everyone. will post final artifacts & ticket link here when done. :rocket:
